jobs.description:
Team-Head Legal Entities / Client Data Management Office
•
Basel, CH
•
Full-time
•
Unlimited
Your Role
The Client Data Management Office is looking for an experienced CDB expert to head its Legal Entities team, which is responsible for reviewing and processing client documentation and client data, ensuring data completeness and correctness throughout the lifecycle of the clients in the Bank.
Your Responsibilities
• Leading a team of Client Data Officers, responsible for Legal Entities
• Reviewing and processing all account openings, ensuring a smooth operational activity for the clients
• Act as the point of contact for our Relationship Managers and provide guidance on account opening standards and documentation gaps enabling them to further develop their business
• Act as the bridge between the Bank's different stakeholders including Front, Legal, Compliance, IT to ensure aligned interests
• Leading Projects to improve the Bank's processes and tools as well as standardizing documentation requirements in line with CDB regulation and Bank directives
• Support the Bank in its continuous move from manual, paper based client files to digital onboarding
• Managing physical and electronic static data throughout the life-cycle of a client
• Ensure excellent client relations and satisfaction as well as handling escalated issues promptly and effectively
• Developing deep understanding of the Bank's processes, products and services
Your Profile
• Banking apprenticeship or relevant degree
• At least 5 years of relevant work experience in Private Banking, preferably as Onboarding Specialist or Compliance Officer
• CDB Expert, specifically in the area of Legal Entities, with sound knowledge of AML, FATCA/QI and CRS regulations
• Strong prioritization, organization and analytical skills are essential
• Reliable team player with excellent communication, interpersonal skills and hands-on mentality
• Creating a productive environment for the team
• Demonstrated ability to take ownership, perform under pressure and set priorities
• Fluency in English and German
• IT affinity, experience in working with Avaloq is advantageous
Your Benefits
•
Entrepreneurial spirit in a family owned bank
•
Central city office locations across Switzerland
•
Above average insurance coverage fully borne by the bank
•
Contribution to health insurance and meal allowance
•
Global growth strategy and stable environment
•
Competitive offering
About us
As a leading sustainable private bank, we offer dynamic and personalized services in investment advisory and asset management for private and institutional clients.
Our success depends on the enthusiasm and commitment of our employees and we value each person with their unique technical expertise, professional qualifications and social skills.
We are successfully operating for more than 180 years across 30 locations worldwide and offer our employees the chance to be a part of our success.
Our employees are our most valuable asset, we are proud of our unique culture that fosters entrepreneurship and is fueled by a high team spirit and
the positive attitude of each individual. Join our international team and be part of the next chapter of the J. Safra Sarasin Group.

Senior Banking Systems Integration Engineer
•
Basel, CH
•
Full-time
•
Unlimited
Your Role
As Senior Banking Systems Integration Engineer at Bank J. Safra Sarasin you are at the forefront of banking innovation and provide cutting-edge integration solutions that power exceptional client experiences at scale.
Your Responsibilities
• Design, build, and maintain scalable services on the Avaloq Container Platform Reference (ACPR/Openshift)
• Develop robust integration solutions utilizing the Avaloq Business Event Grid (BEG)
• Contribute to strategic integration projects featuring bi-directional, real-time message streaming (Kafka)
• Diagnose and resolve complex integration issues across multiple channels
• Partner with infrastructure and release management teams to guarantee end-to-end solution quality, from design to deployment
• Support testing campaigns and rollouts
Your Profile
• Higher education (university / FH) in Computer Science, Business Information Systems or in a comparable field
• An Avaloq Academy Professional Certification e.g. Avaloq Certified Integration Professional (ACIP) is an advantage
• 5 years of practical experience in the field of system integration in the banking industry
• Experience with Avaloq
• Knowledge in Openshift, OpenAPI, Apache Kafka, .NET is an advantage
• Ability to weigh problems and set priorities
• Strong analytical and problem solving skills
• Hands-on mentality and capability to work independently
• Fluency in English

jobs.description:
Senior Backup Engineer
•
Basel, CH
•
Full-time
•
Unlimited
Your Role
As Senior Backup Engineer at Bank J. Safra Sarasin you are responsible for the administration and monitoring of our enterprise backup environment and provide a reliable, high-quality service to the Bank's critical systems.
Your Responsibilities
• Support backup & restore operational activities
• Collaborate on the design and execution of disaster recovery tests
• Implement monitoring and automation for backup and restore operations
• Collaborate on the design and evolution of the backup infrastructure, supporting the architectural evolution of legacy systems and migration projects
• Assist the team on infrastructure related tasks, including on-call service
Your Profile
• Higher education in Computer Science (University/FH)
• At least 3 - 5 years of practical experience in the field of backup management, engineering, and enterprise backup solutions
• Good foundational knowledge in SAN storage, Linux, and Windows, with specific expertise in data recovery exercises and Disaster Recovery Plans
• Familiarity with Linux (Red Hat) and UNIX-based OS systems and a strong affinity for automation are highly valued
• ITIL and TOGAF certifications are considered an advantage
• A hands-on professional with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, capable of effectively weighing issues, setting priorities, and taking full ownership of tasks
• A team player characterized by strong work ethics, integrity, and high accountability
• Fluent in English; proficiency in German and/or French is a plus

As Treasury Operations Specialist at Bank J. Safra Sarasin you are part of a unique group environment where domestic and international cross-divisional collaboration meets global impact. • Analyze and clear outstanding reconciliation discrepancies until fully resolved
• Foster cooperative, goal-oriented collaboration with internal Operations teams and business divisions across Switzerland and international markets
• Assist the Department Head with the management of key projects and urgent ad-hoc assignments

• Professional education in business or economics or completed apprenticeship within a financial services firm
• Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in Treasury

As a (Senior) FIX Engineer Specialist at Bank J. Cash and Securities Reconciliation Specialist
•
Basel, CH
•
Full-time
•
Unlimited
Your Role
As Cash and Securities Reconciliation Specialist at Bank J. Safra Sarasin you are entrusted with the responsible role of reconciling transactions with our custodians and cash correspondents, including monitoring of any difference identified. Become part of this important team in analyzing potential discrepancies and proactively contributing to their timely resolution to minimize the bank's risks. The exciting, international environment includes close collaboration with different areas of the bank and an overall understanding of the related operational transactions.
Your Responsibilities
• Manage daily / weekly / monthly / annual Cash- and Securities- reconciliation processes by identifying discrepancies and allocating them to the relevant departments
• Reconcile physical securities and land registry extracts by physical stock taking
• Investigate issues, monitor open items and follow up on resolutions
• Coordinate special reconciliations completed by various teams within Operations
• Participate in the annual Audit in relation to the reconciliation process
• Contribute to the process improvements and automation efforts in order to support efficiency gains and operational risk mitigation
Your Profile
• University degree in Finance / Accounting / Controlling or completed apprenticeship or similar banking education
• 2 - 5 years of practical experience in the field of Operations / Backoffice or Finance / Controlling; industry specific knowledge is an advantage
• Excellent Microsoft Office skills; Avaloq experience is an advantage
• Strong analytical and problem solving skills combined with strong work ethics, integrity and high level of accountability
• Fluency in English; fluency in German is a plus
Your Benefits
•
Entrepreneurial spirit in a family owned bank
•
Central city office locations across Switzerland
•
Above average insurance coverage fully borne by the bank
•
Contribution to health insurance and meal allowance
•
Global growth strategy and stable environment
•
Competitive offering
About us
As a leading sustainable private bank, we offer dynamic and personalized services in investment advisory and asset management for private and institutional clients.
Our success depends on the enthusiasm and commitment of our employees and we value each person with their unique technical expertise, professional qualifications and social skills.
We are successfully operating for more than 180 years across 30 locations worldwide and offer our employees the chance to be a part of our success.
Our employees are our most valuable asset, we are proud of our unique culture that fosters entrepreneurship and is fueled by a high team spirit and
the positive attitude of each individual. Join our international team and be part of the next chapter of the J. Safra Sarasin Group.
